purpose: Define and manage custom log level sets using OTLP severity numbers (1-24). Provides Spec-based lookups, comparison, and formatting — no logging output itself.
keyExports: LogLevels — Main class implementing IBasic. Constructed from a LogLevelsSet. Provides asSpec(), maxWidth(), defaultLevel, warnLevel, flushLevel, specMap, specArray.
IBasic — Interface contract for log level managers; used as the type for logLevels references throughout @epdoc/logger.
Spec — The primary data object: { name, severity, fmtFn?, icon? }. Passed around instead of raw names or severity numbers.
LogLevelsSpec — Config for a single level without a name: { severity, fmtFn?, icon? }. Used inside LogLevelsSet definitions.
LogLevelsSet — Constructor argument: { id: string, levels: Record<Name, LogLevelsSpec> }.
Name — Type alias for string (a level name like 'INFO').
Severity — Type alias for Integer (OTLP severity number 1-24).
compareLevels(a, b) — Standalone function: compares two Specs by severity, returns +1/0/-1.
applyColors(msg, spec) — Standalone function: applies spec.fmtFn to a string.
isSpec(val) — Type guard for Spec objects.
isLogLevelSpec(obj), isLogLevelMap(obj), isLogLevelsSet(obj) — Type guards for config types.

keyPatterns.name: Spec-based level passing
keyPatterns.description: Instead of passing level names (string) or severity numbers, pass Spec objects. Use asSpec() to convert, then access .name, .severity, .fmtFn directly.

keyPatterns.name: Well-known severity anchors
keyPatterns.description: defaultLevel (severity 9), warnLevel (severity 13), and flushLevel (severity 17) are fixed anchors. Every LogLevelsSet must include levels at these severities.

keyPatterns.name: Threshold comparison
keyPatterns.description: Compare levels via spec.severity >= threshold.severity, or use compareLevels(spec, threshold) for a CompareResult (+1/0/-1).

keyPatterns.name: Import convention
keyPatterns.description: Consumers import as: import * as Level from '@epdoc/loglevels'; then reference Level.Spec, Level.Name, Level.IBasic, new Level.LogLevels(), Level.isSpec(), etc.

architecture.flow: LogLevelsSet (config) → LogLevels constructor → specMap + specArray → asSpec() lookups
architecture.keyDesign: Spec is the universal currency. All level identity flows through Spec objects rather than raw strings or numbers. LogLevels is a leaf dependency with no internal package deps.
